constraints: Use generated prime-order curves over nine distinct field primes with trace not in {0,1} and j not in {0,1728}.
Use 31 independent random-scalar and 31 random-x null factor bases per curve.
Use exact four- and eight-term supports; unordered occupancy is a sizing control only.
Use the exact uniform-permutation first-hit expectation per target; retain four preregistered support-order permutations as a secondary implementation control.
Charge modular-exponentiation proxies, coordinate RHS arithmetic, and rational-map arithmetic separately from group operations.
Treat results as TOY-EVIDENCE and prohibit split-compression, exponent, deployment, rank, or descent claims unless separately measured.
research_question.decision_target: Decide whether any frozen coordinate family passes the exploratory sign-complete eight-term finite-null and exact uniform-order frontier gate after special-curve, repeated-field, support-order, and coordinate-cost confounds are controlled.
research_question.motivation: EXP-ECDLP-RECURSIVE-001 verified a sign-complete m=8 coverage/first-witness signal, but every passing four-term support was maximal, one curve was anomalous, and one-draw controls varied too widely for family inference. The first successor audit additionally found command, budget, positive-control, order, and cost-accounting defects that v2 must repair before execution.

curve_families: generated non-supersingular, non-anomalous, non-special-j prime-order short-Weierstrass curves
field_types: prime fields constrained to p mod 4 = 3
methods: exact signed four- and eight-term support
exact uniform-order and shuffled first-witness scans

research_question.title: Null-calibrated recursive coverage on non-special curves
